subject: BluePeak partnership — reference architecture sanity check
messages:
From: Carlos Mejia <carlos@bluepeak.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: partners@bluepeak.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: BluePeak x Redwood — reference arch + validation request

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. As discussed, we're preparing a short technical validation so BluePeak can recommend Redwood to a set of enterprise clients that need a managed inference partner. I've attached a first-pass reference architecture (BluePeak_Redwood_Reference_Arch_v1.pdf) and a short list of questions.

High level: customers will run pre-processing and business logic in their VPC; they want Redwood to host model inference (either hosted API or Dedicated) with private connectivity (VPC peering / PrivateLink). Critical items for them are:
- predictable latency under 200ms p95 for conversational use-cases
- audit logs and data residency in us-west
- SOC2 controls and evidence for third-party audits

Could the Redwood team do a quick sanity check on the attached reference arch and call out any immediate compatibility gaps or gating items? Ideally we can sync next week for a 30–45 min technical review and agree on a small PoC scope (1 customer, 2 model variants).

Attachments: BluePeak_Redwood_Reference_Arch_v1.pdf

Thanks,
Carlos Mejia
Head of Partnerships, BluePeak Consulting
car los@bluepeak.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Mejia <carlos@bluepeak.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BluePeak x Redwood — reference arch + validation request

Carlos —

Appreciate the doc, this is the right level of detail to start. I've looped in Sergio (platform eng) and Karthik (solutions) so we can validate the network and deployment assumptions. Quick notes reading the reference:
- Private connectivity (VPC peering vs PrivateLink) has tradeoffs; we'll surface recommendations in the review.
- Latency SLOs are feasible but depend on model size/quantization and whether KV prefix caching is available for the workload.
- SOC2 evidence: we can provide the relevant attestations and logging export options — we’ll confirm retention policies per region.

Can we do Wed 14 Jan at 10:00 PT for a 45 min tech review? If that works I'll send a calendar invite and a short pre-read (Confluence link).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-2323

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>

Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 10:53:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BluePeak x Redwood — reference arch + validation request

Marissa / Carlos —

Thanks for the pre-read and scheduling. I reviewed BluePeak_Redwood_Reference_Arch_v1.pdf and pulled a few items that we'd like clarified before the call so the meeting is focused and we can produce an actionable notes doc.

Questions / clarifications:
1) Traffic patterns: you list "spikes up to 200 r/s" — is that sustained or burst? What's the expected steady-state throughput during business hours?
2) Payload sizes: what's the typical prompt + context token size? Any multimodal payloads?
3) Authentication: do you expect customers to use per-tenant API keys, or will BluePeak route on a shared integration account with tenant headers?
4) Private connectivity: the doc shows VPC peering; some customers prefer PrivateLink (no transitive routing). Any constraints on the peer model?
5) Logging / retention: please confirm whether 30/90/365 day retention is required for different logs (audit, request/response traces).

I've attached a short capacity worksheet (prelim-capacity-estimate.xlsx) internally to help size Dedicated pool recommendations — I'll share numbers on the call.

If the answers above are available ahead of the call it will let us run an initial capacity + cost estimate. Otherwise we can cover on Wed.

— Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Principal Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai

From: Alicia Song <alicia.song@bluepeak.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Carlos Mejia <carlos@bluepeak.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BluePeak x Redwood — reference arch + validation request

Marissa / Sergio / Karthik —

Thanks for the questions — quick answers below so you can finalize the capacity estimate before Wednesday's call:

1) Traffic patterns: expect steady-state ~40–60 r/s per customer during business hours, bursts up to ~220 r/s for 30–120s during peak events. We'll scope PoC with a single customer at ~75 r/s steady.
2) Payload sizes: average prompt+context ~3.5k tokens, 95th percentile ~8k tokens. No multimodal at this stage.
3) Authentication: customers prefer per-tenant API keys managed by BluePeak. BluePeak will forward tenant id headers.
4) Private connectivity: customers prefer PrivateLink where available; VPC peering is acceptable for on-premise customers.
5) Logging / retention: audit logs 365 days; request/response traces 90 days.

I've attached an updated diagram (network-diagram.png) that clarifies the inbound path and recommended PrivateLink endpoints. Also attached our filled SOC2 questionnaire (SOC2-questionnaire.xlsx).

For the PoC we propose:
- 4 week pilot
- initial traffic target 75 r/s; synthetic load driver provided by BluePeak
- two model variants: a distilled 7B and a quantized 13B

Let us know if the above is enough for your sizing. Happy to jump on a 30 min pre-call if helpful.

Best,
Alicia Song
Technical Program Manager, BluePeak Consulting
alicia.song@bluepeak.com

Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BluePeak x Redwood — reference arch + validation request

Alicia / Carlos —

Thanks for the quick follow-up and the updated assets — the network diagram and SOC2 questionnaire are really helpful. Sergio and Karthik ran initial sizing: for the PoC target (75 r/s steady, bursts to 220 r/s, avg 3.5k tokens, p95 8k) we recommend a Dedicated pool with 8x A100-equivalent capacity and a pre-warmed cache layer to hit the 200ms p95 target for the distilled 7B; the quantized 13B will be closer to ~300ms p95 unless we apply further kernel-level optimizations. We'll include the preliminary numbers in the meeting notes.

Next steps (agreed):
- Wed 21 Jan 10:00 PT: technical deep dive (30 min) — agenda: network, auth model, pilot sizing, logging/export paths.
- Redwood to produce a short runbook for PrivateLink setup + firewall rules (action: Sergio).
- BluePeak to share the PoC customer contact and test data window (action: Alicia).
- Legal / procurement: Marissa to start an SOW draft and attach the SOC2 evidence for the customer (action: Marissa + Laura).

I'll send the calendar invite and a short pre-read (Confluence link) in the next hour. Looking forward to the call.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-2323
